svg.text: J1 — 24-way (2×12) 0.156" card-edge socket, mates with PET IEEE-488 port · pins 1–12 on one side, A–N on the other · GND = pins 12, F, H, J, K, L, M, N
IEEE-488 TEST PLUG — Commodore PET universal board — for IEEETEST.PRG
R1–R16: 680 Ω ¼ W D1–D16: green or yellow LED, Vf ≈ 2.0–2.2 V (not red: idle bus ≈ 3.3 V can make red glow)
S1–S14: SPST to ground, no series resistor (two 8-way DIP switches work) C1: 100 nF ceramic
LED lights when the line is LOW (asserted). All switches OFF except when the program asks for one.
REN is grounded inside the PET, so D16 is always lit: it doubles as a 'plug fitted and powered' indicator.
Before first use: check J1 pins 12 and N read 0 Ω to the PET chassis to confirm orientation.
LED numbers match the program's prompts (#1–#16); edge-connector pin shown under each channel
